text: {"lessons":["Avoid reacting to ordinary month-to-month fluctuations; my patience through the early periods was consistent with my long-term approach.","Selling part of Stock B and Stock D locked in gains and reduced exposure, but a gain versus my average cost alone is not a reason to sell; consider each stock’s outlook and portfolio risk.","Because losses feel especially painful and gains satisfying, watch for loss aversion and premature profit-taking; make future trades using a consistent plan rather than emotion."]}
